claim.value: A retained subset does not prove an underlying causal mechanism.
claim.scope: Causal interpretation of a reduction result, distinct from test-relative reproduction.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly states this limitation on interpreting a retained subset.

signal_basis.value: Under fixed test conditions and a common repetition rule, a reduced configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to reproduce it; inconsistent outcomes remain unresolved.
signal_basis.scope: Reduction tests of the selected late-start case.

provenance.rationale: The cited bundle supplies the observed reduction pattern, controlled conditions, repetition rule, unresolved-outcome qualification and selected failure.
The claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Repeated reproduction and removal tests establish behavior under the test conditions. They do not by themselves identify the underlying causal mechanism. The claim correctly limits what this signal establishes, even with execution prerequisites satisfied.
uncertainty: The mechanism remains unidentified by this signal; that does not create uncertainty about the stated inferential limitation.
